trello.name: Finalize venue contract
trello.desc: Submit the convention center contract for legal review, obtain signature by end of next week, and secure written confirmation that the AV package includes recording capabilities for all three rooms.

trello.name: Lock final speaker lineup
trello.desc: Send final follow-ups to two tentative speakers with a Friday decision deadline, secure a replacement from the backup list if needed to reach nine speakers, and lock the final lineup within two weeks to allow for agenda printing.

trello.name: Obtain keynote abstract
trello.desc: Contact Dr. Osei to obtain the keynote abstract within this week to ensure it is ready for the website and printed program.

trello.name: Draft and execute registration email campaign
trello.desc: Draft three email campaign waves (agenda announcement, early-bird reminder, final push) within this month, and execute the first wave on the day the agenda goes live.

trello.name: Hand off speaker assets for website
trello.desc: Immediately transfer speaker bios and headshots to Diego on the same day the lineup is locked so the landing page speaker profiles can be updated.

trello.name: Approve swag design proofs
trello.desc: Review the swag design proofs located in the shared drive today.

trello.name: Place swag order
trello.desc: Immediately place the order for 800 shirts, 500 notebooks, and 1,000 stickers once design proofs are approved to meet the six-week lead time.
